The plate is a square-ish plate about 20-26 cm across. It holds 5 roasted potato (or turnip) chunks, each roughly 3-4 cm. Each chunk weighs about 20-25 g, so the total is about 110 g. Roasted potato runs about 1.0-1.3 kcal/g, which gives roughly 120 kcal. If the pieces are turnip or radish, the energy would be lower. A little oil is visible, so I settled on about 110 kcal.
